freeze_note: Candidate frozen specification; final execution is forbidden until this exact file and the declared attempts are committed by the campaign coordinator. No final posterior result informed this specification.
question: Do exoplanet/PyMC and independent batman/juliet/dynesty recover compatible posterior distributions from identical Kepler-10 b observations under matched physical and statistical assumptions?
hypothesis: Matched predictions and priors can yield compatible posterior distributions despite different numerical engines and samplers; disagreement or numerical inadequacy remains reportable.
independence_limit: Independent transit implementation and sampler; same observations and physical assumptions. Computational agreement is not independent astrophysical truth or proof of uncertainty calibration.

dataset.row_selection: Exactly all historical M5 input rows, unchanged and in original order. No Silver/Gold regeneration or posterior-dependent clipping.

comparison_contract.rule: Same input bytes, rows, errors, exposures, segments and numerical array SHA256.
Relative flux/errors, original phase in DAYS unchanged, circular fixed period .8374907 days. Original time retained for temporal residual diagnostics, not replaced by phase order.
r=p_p1 Uniform(.001,.2); b=b_p1 Uniform(0,1); a=a_p1 Uniform(2,50); e=0, omega=90deg; i=acos(b/a). No redundant density prior. New shared Uniform prior is not scientific_003's historical LogNormal.
Quadratic law; independent q1,q2 Uniform(0,1); u1=2sqrt(q1)q2, u2=sqrt(q1)(1-2q2).
Local B~Normal(1,.02). juliet constant regressor theta0~Normal(0,.02), mdilution=1,mflux=0; B=1+theta0. One shared offset, no added segment fit parameters.
Normal(0,.025) DAYS relative to stored phase center; no literature transit-time likelihood added.
Independent Normal variance sigma_i^2+j^2. j~HalfNormal(max(5median(sigma_i),.0005)); juliet sigma_w=1e6*j ppm, zero-mean TruncatedNormal [0,+infinity]. No temporal covariance.

15 equal-weight midpoint Riemann nodes at original exposure; batman endpoint span contracted by14/15 for identical nodes. Physical exposure metadata unchanged. Exact exposure groups share every nuisance prior.
Independent routines are not bit-identical. Pre-final engineering 3-regime fixture tolerance2e-8 relative flux; errors are recorded. This finite grid is not a global accuracy proof.
PyMC NUTS versus static dynesty multi/rwalk, serial external worker. Diagnose each appropriately; no Rhat/BFMI on unordered nested samples.

seed_policy: campaign_plan.seed(campaign_id,'PUB-03',engine_scenario_id,'rep_0000',stream): first32bits SHA256 of canonical JSON ['campaign-seed-v1',campaign_id,experiment_id,scenario_id,replicate_id,stream]. Engine scenarios kepler_10_b_local and kepler_10_b_external; streams inference,predictive,resampling. Store all integer seeds in the committed campaign ledger before execution. No reseeding/selection; any technical retry uses the identical seed and is separately recorded. Numerical-gate rejection is never retried to seek a pass.
derived_parameters: Geometric depth=r^2; T14=P/pi asin(sqrt(((1+r)^2-b^2)/(a^2-b^2))) DAYS; not observed limb-darkened depth.
primary_metrics: absolute difference of posterior means / sqrt(sd_local^2+sd_external^2)
empirical CDF maximum distance without iid KS-test pvalue
secondary_metrics: posterior predictive curves and standardized residuals
discrepancy_flags: Descriptive material-disagreement flags: standardized center difference>2, 94% interval disjoint, width ratio outside [.5,2], standardized Wasserstein>1 or empiricalCDF distance>.2. These are investigation triggers, not hypothesis-test levels or proof of equivalence if not exceeded. Always publish continuous metrics.

gates.local: All scalar Rhat<=1.01, bulk/tailESS>=400, zero divergences, BFMI>=.30; inherited plus temporal publication PPC and provenance checks.
gates.external: Budget limit not reached, weighted nested ESS>=400, logZ standard error<=.5. This does not prove discovery of every mode; inspect warnings and posterior geometry. maxcall/maxiter stop means rejected, never successful convergence.
gates.ppc: Observed94 predictive coverage [.80,.99], standardized residual SD [.5,2]; within-segment gap-filtered selected-observation lag correlations as shared inference.residual_correlations. Cadence proxy is median selected time spacing, not native-cadence exclusion: PASS cannot rule out short-timescale noise removed by downsampling. At least one finite evaluable lag is required; undefined/insufficient-pair correlation is unavailable and rejects positive scientific interpretation, not an observed correlation failure. Jitter/median_error<=20, inherited radius review-range mass<=.05 outside [.00349,.24751]. Heuristics, not calibrated tests.
gates.comparison: Positive compatibility claim requires both numerical gates and a valid comparison contract. Rejected/unresolved runs may support negative or inconclusive findings, never positive external validation. No evidence/LOO ranking.

inclusion: Both declared engine attempts on identical observations. No rejection based on agreement, posterior width, unfavorable physical estimate or seed.
exclusion: Engineering fixtures/pilots excluded from final inference claims. No final target, row or attempt exclusions.
failure_policy: Preserve partial outputs, warnings, failed/timeout status and every declared attempt. Missing posterior means missing comparison, not zero discrepancy. No automatic best-of retry. An implementation defect requires dated amendment and new run identity; original evidence remains.
pilot_policy: Tiny nlive20/maxcall100 pilot may test parser/RNG/termination only. Deliberate stopping should fail promotion. No pilot posterior comparison is final evidence.
rng_contract: Seed dynesty with explicit Generator through the tested ExplicitRNGNestedSampler bridge: juliet2.2.10 otherwise silently drops rstate because dynesty3.1.0 inherits its constructor. The bridge delegates unchanged to the installed class and restores it after the serial worker fit. juliet native equal-weight resampling also omits RNG: retain native files but derive canonical posterior separately from raw weighted samples using an independent seeded Generator. No native unseeded resample may feed comparisons.
allowed_interpretation: Computational compatibility or disagreement conditional on these priors, exact rows and white likelihood; no recalibration or rewrite of historical scientific_003; no claim of catalog-independent truth or population generalization.
hypothesis_rejection: Material posterior disagreement unexplained by finite computation rejects compatibility under this contract. Failed sampler/PPC or budget exhaustion makes positive compatibility unsupported, not automatically a defect of either transit engine.
